design: Change only acceptance attribution, and separate it from timing. Reuse exact v6 source text; preserve all v6 outputs. A recommendation alone does not establish acceptance, but an explicitly reported agreement inside a recommendation still counts. Frozen AI-authored diagnostic expectations are not human adjudications. Use native Noul only; v6 found no binary difference between response types.

acceptance_criteria.true: The actor is reported as accepting this specific change.
acceptance_criteria.false: Acceptance is not reported. A request, recommendation, or proposed condition alone is insufficient.

questions.reference_quote: agreed to modify its proposal to reduce the height of the building from 164 feet to 154 feet
questions.reason: The board condition on page 8 does not itself report applicant acceptance; page 11 does.

questions.question: Does `report.text` explicitly say the proposed building height was reduced after certification?

criteria.true: The height change is explicitly placed after certification.
criteria.false: Only a later recommendation is dated, or the timing of the height change is not stated.

questions.reference_quote: After certification, the applicant revised its development
questions.reason: Date of a board request is distinct from the date of an accepted change.

questions.reference_quote: the applicant has expressed that it will fulfill all of the conditions of the Community Board
questions.reason: The full report records revised plans and an undertaking to fulfill the conditions; the excerpt gives only the parking recommendation.

questions.action: provide at least 50 percent two-bedroom units
questions.reference_quote: agrees to at least a minimum of 50% two bedroom units
questions.reason: Explicit agreement within board conditions must survive the clarification.

questions.reference_quote: the applicant has committed to provide meeting space within the building for tenants
questions.reason: An explicit voluntary commitment counts even when it is not a CPC approval condition.

questions.action: a restrictive declaration limiting the site to 412 dwelling units
questions.reference_quote: would limit the number of dwelling units on the site to 412
questions.reason: A specific agreed density cap must remain positive.

questions.action: add the planted-buffer provision to the urban renewal plan
questions.reference_quote: the Public Development Corporation agreed to add this provision to the urban renewal plan
questions.reason: Explicit agency/applicant agreement to a mitigation provision must remain positive.
